changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Normalize known employee statuses and enforce the canonical employment-status domain.
changeSet.sql:
DO $$ DECLARE invalid_statuses TEXT; BEGIN SELECT string_agg(quote_literal(invalid_status.status), ', ' ORDER BY invalid_status.status) INTO invalid_statuses FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT status FROM "${schema}".employee WHERE UPPER(BTRIM(status)) NOT IN ( 'ACTIVE', 'PROBATION', 'INACTIVE', 'ON_LEAVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'TERMINATED' ) ) AS invalid_status;
IF invalid_statuses IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514', MESSAGE = format( 'unknown employee status values in schema %s: %s. Allowed statuses: ACTIVE, PROBATION, INACTIVE, ON_LEAVE, SUSPENDED, TERMINATED', '${schema}', invalid_statuses ); END IF; END $$;

UPDATE "${schema}".employee SET status = UPPER(BTRIM(status)) WHERE UPPER(BTRIM(status)) IN ( 'ACTIVE', 'PROBATION', 'INACTIVE', 'ON_LEAVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'TERMINATED' ) AND status <> UPPER(BTRIM(status));
ALTER TABLE "${schema}".employee ADD CONSTRAINT ck_employee_status_canonical CHECK (status IN ( 'ACTIVE', 'PROBATION', 'INACTIVE', 'ON_LEAVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'TERMINATED' ));

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE "${schema}".employee DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_employee_status_canonical;
